generation:dmd2_sdxl_lora.title: DMD2 SDXL four-step LoRA (two precisions)

release.note: Method paper date is not established upload date of either selected LoRA.

license.note: Author GitHub LICENSE.md agrees with README, while HF tag omits ShareAlike. Retain metadata conflict and source provenance.

dependencies: Compatible SDXL base checkpoint, encoders/VAE, LoRA loader and trained sampling schedule

proposed_app_starting_profile.evidence: Author-linked Comfy example uses this sampler/CFG for the DMD2 4-step UNet; applying it to the selected LoRA is a proposed app recipe, not an exact-artifact benchmark.

settings.note: Author suggests lower LoRA scale may suit community models. Diffusers guidance=0 disables CFG; Comfy uses CFG1 for this behavior, while CFG0 would favor unconditional output.

hardware_notes: Adapter alone is small relative to SDXL pipeline. Four sampling steps reduce denoising work, not necessarily peak VRAM or memory of the underlying checkpoint.
